sources: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 5 (all pages via campsitePaging.do, 203 of 213 campsites parsed)

values.note: Reservations need at least 2 nights until DEC's season opens (May 8 in 2026, when its first campgrounds open): 'When the first campground opens for the season, the reservation minimums at all facilities will become 1 night until closing.' DEC's 2026 campground summary. ReserveAmerica, up to 9 months ahead, same day included. A permit runs at most 14 nights, and from July 1 through Labor Day only 14 cumulative nights are allowed at any campground. Register by 9 pm on the first night or the site is re-rented.

booking.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/north-south%20lake%20campground/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=5 (Booking Window: Campsite 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 9 Month(s) in advance'; LENGTH OF STAY 'maximum of 14 nights. From July 1 through Labor Day only 14 cumulative nights'; CHECK-IN TIME 'by 9:00 p.m. on the first night') + DEC 2026 campground summary (RES MIN 2), read 2026-10-21

values.note: DEC lists 219 campsites in seven loops; ReserveAmerica's equipment lengths are mostly 20 ft (126 of 203 parsed), with 62 at 30 ft, 13 at 40 ft and one at 25 ft; two pull-throughs (20 and 30 ft). Heavily wooded.

note: The highest-elevation state campground in the Catskills.  Some campsites are on the lake.  --AWH
summary: Confirmed $22 + $5 non-resident and the 2-night pre-season reservation minimum (DEC 2026 summary), ReserveAmerica 9-month window and 14-night max (now on the entry), season May 14 - Oct 23 2027 (matches). Added 219 sites (mostly 20 ft, some 30-40 ft, two pull-throughs), no electric, showers, dump. Dropped the --Claude minimum-stay line (redundant with booking). Not stated: water at sites.
flags: Missing phone: North-South Lake Campground (518) 589-5058 (ReserveAmerica 'Project Office' contact; DEC 2026 campground summary gives 518-589-5058).
Minor: 126 of the 203 parsed sites are listed at 20 ft, so a 23-ft rig should pick from the 76 sites listed at 25-40 ft.

Weak waterfront lead: ReserveAmerica marks all 203 parsed campsites 'Near Water - no', against the lakefront value and the --AWH 'Some campsites are on the lake'. AWH's firsthand note supports the current value; the RA tag may simply be unpopulated.
